# 多時間框架動能策略 (Binance 即時)
# RSI(14) 1h + SMA 交叉 4h + 成交量確認

class MomentumStrategy:
    """
    BUY  條件: RSI(1h) < 45 AND price > SMA(4h,20) AND vol > 1.2× 均量
    SELL 條件: RSI(1h) > 65 OR price < SMA(4h,20) × 0.98
    信心度 = 加權評分(RSI:45% + SMA:30% + VOL:25%)
    """

    def evaluate(self, ticker):
        rsi    = ta.rsi(ticker.klines_1h, 14)
        sma    = ta.sma(ticker.klines_4h, 20)
        vol_ok = ticker.volume > ticker.avg_volume * 1.2

        score = self.weighted_score(rsi, sma, vol_ok)
        return score, self.to_signal(score)
